One circuit per endpoint pair, fail-to-engage external pin springs. Select actual coil voltage/current, flow, seals and ports.

interface_requirements.notes: Accessible isolation/bleed for maintenance; do not assume existing compressor isolator serves this branch.
Cut allowance; final OD/ID and flex radius selected to cylinder/valve fittings. Route and measure before cutting.
Do not guess small port threads from nominal cylinder body.
Split each endpoint circuit to two cylinders.
Two supply and two output connections across two valves.
One per3/2 valve; keep exhaust release unrestricted.
Complete supply/regulator/isolator connection set, including verified hose to owned compressor.

Size actual sensor/valve/kit demand; existing machine supply may serve only after verified capacity, isolation and protection. No unverified ownership credit.
All12 sensors, motor,2 valves and kit interfaces. Physical cable lengths, strain relief and rear flex loop must be measured; one complete procurement set.
Secure6mm manual index pin to fixed keeper.
8 guide/cradle+4 independent hood-support frame attachments. Match profile groove and safe insertion/engagement.
No free offcut credit; keep precision rail seats clean and re-inspect after welding.
Belt safe-end retention and fixed/continuous cable guides; exact selected interfaces conditional.

runtime_interface_metadata.current_steel_gate: Manual opening before cold wood job; parked/closed input required for plasma. It is not the vendor servo dust cover.

limits: All ATC stock/hardware unowned unless independently verified. No pricing or vendor hole templates.
Full custom STEP files bind the actual current shape; uniform-profile DXFs only are manufacturing contours. Reference sections omit other-axis features and blind operations.
Welded cradles, hood/drive-case/gate/guide constituents and RHS cuts are explicit. Stock rows are additive; assembly/reference rows are nonadditive.
Bore cylinders in nominal-thread STEP geometry are not tap drills. Actual vendor fits, strengths, welds, thermal limits, controls and operating trials remain qualified separately.
Steel blanks are finished rectangular envelopes, not a claimed combined sheet nest. No offcuts are credited.
